facts.label: Gostos com gerúndio
facts.sub: Depois de enjoy, like, love e hate, use o verbo com -ing: I enjoy cooking. I hate washing dishes. Do you like baking?

facts.label: Enjoy
facts.sub: Use enjoy + verbo com -ing para falar do que dá prazer: I enjoy cooking. Depois de enjoy nunca use to + verbo. Diga enjoy making soup, enjoy listening to music.

facts.label: Love
facts.sub: Love mostra que você gosta muito: I love baking bread. Depois de love, use -ing ou to + verbo, mas hoje use -ing. É mais comum em frases que falam de hábitos.

We say “I enjoy to cook.” → Falso (After enjoy, use -ing.)

pages.title: A warm kitchen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold Sunday afternoon in Boston. Nina’s kitchen smells like fresh bread. A big pot sits on the stove. Tom arrives with a bag of vegetables. He puts on an old apron. They love spending Sundays together.

“Tom, I really enjoy cooking on Sundays. Do you like cooking?” says Nina. “I love cooking, but I hate cutting onions. They make me cry.” says Tom. “I don’t mind cutting them. I enjoy making soup with them.” says Nina.
